hoods.ID: chart-projects, insight:join, table:hoods — the neighbourhood number; renovation buildings join on it (PROJECT_ID)
hoods.NAME: map-layers, table:hoods, insight:whole, chart-areas — names starting 'כל ' mark whole-settlement areas
hoods.SETTLEMENT: skip: settlement code, the name (SETTLEME_1) is shown instead
hoods.DISTRICT_C: chart-districts, insight:district_lead — mapped to the districts layer's CODE; code 0 placed by centroid
hoods.TYPE: chart-codes, map-layers — undocumented code, shown as is
hoods.ACTIVITY: chart-codes, chart-districts, map-layers, table:hoods — undocumented code, shown as is
hoods.SHAPE_STAr: chart-areas, insight:whole, table:hoods — area in ITM m²; geometry area as fallback
hoods.SHAPE_STLe: skip: perimeter, adds nothing to the area
hoods.__geometry: map-layers, chart-districts — drawn; centroid places code-0 areas in a district
reno.PROJECT_ID: insight:join, table:hoods — joins buildings to their neighbourhood
reno.SUBPROJECT: map-layers — compound name in the building popup
reno.HOUSE_NUMB: map-layers — address in the building popup
reno.HOUSE_STAT: chart-projects — status code, orders the statuses
reno.HOUSE_ST_1: chart-projects, chart-years, chart-public, chart-apts, chart-floors, kpi:done, insight:status, map-layers
reno.APT_RENTED: chart-public, insight:public_housing, map-layers — public-housing apartments (DOCX legend)
reno.NUM_KNISSO: chart-floors — mean entrances per floor count, total in the note
reno.LAST_BITSU: chart-years, insight:years, map-layers — date of last renovation, YYYYMMDD
reno.Shape_Area: skip: footprint area, the outline is drawn instead
reno.__geometry: map-layers — building footprints (dots at low zoom)
districts.NAME: chart-districts, map-layers, insight:district_lead
districts.SHAPE_STAr: chart-districts — district area (km²) in its table
districts.__geometry: map-layers, chart-districts — outlines; point in polygon for code-0 areas
